mission: Build high-quality, trustworthy, reproducible datasets and capability packages that customers can evaluate before purchase.
commercial_rule: Never market a dataset as universally superior. Describe the tested use cases, evidence, limitations, provenance, version, and evaluation results.
ownership_rule: DreamCo may claim authorship of original material it creates, subject to applicable law and agreements. Source material and third-party rights remain distinct and must be tracked.
customer_value: provide clean provenance and licensing metadata
north_star: Become exceptionally good at turning legitimate source knowledge, original research, synthetic generation, human expertise, and evaluation evidence into useful, auditable, capability-specific data products.
